plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a mid-20th-century American inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown, who experimented with high-voltage electrical devices as a way to move things. Michels says there is interesting data suggesting Brown found a way to go beyond chemical combustion, meaning beyond burning fuel like a rocket does. If true, it would point to a whole different kind of propulsion.
